night2_start.name: {name}
night2_start.text: *Back home. I showered and lay in bed — then the messenger notifications start pouring in.*

night2_msg_dain_specific.name: Dain
night2_msg_dain_specific.text: Hey!! The tteokbokki today was amazing!!

night2_msg_dain_specific_2.name: Dain
night2_msg_dain_specific_2.text: Let's bet again tomorrow!! Different event!!

night2_msg_seo_specific.name: Seoyeon
night2_msg_seo_specific.text: Thanks for today. We finished early thanks to you

night2_msg_seo_specific_2.name: Seoyeon
night2_msg_seo_specific_2.text: I might call on you again next time, so brace yourself

night2_msg_seo_general.name: Seoyeon
night2_msg_seo_general.text: I'll leave the rooftop open at lunch tomorrow. Come

night2_msg_dain_general.name: Dain
night2_msg_dain_general.text: Hey, let's hit the snack shop tomorrow! I'm still bummed we missed it today!

night2_msg_dain_general_merge.name: Seoyeon
night2_msg_dain_general_merge.text: Want to come to the rooftop at lunch? The breeze will be nice

night2_msg_seo_general_alt.name: Seoyeon
night2_msg_seo_general_alt.text: I'll leave the rooftop open tomorrow. Come if you have time

night2_msg_yuna_general.name: Yuna
night2_msg_yuna_general.text: ...are you coming to the annex tomorrow?

night2_msg_generic.name: Dain
night2_msg_generic.text: Hey!! You're coming to the school store tomorrow, right?!

night2_msg_generic_2.name: Seoyeon
night2_msg_generic_2.text: I'll leave the rooftop open at lunch tomorrow

night2_msg_generic_3.name: Yuna
night2_msg_generic_3.text: ...Are you coming to the library tomorrow?

night2_msg_7.name: {name}
night2_msg_7.text: *I need to reply to all three at the same time. — I'm not sure if this is bliss or torture.*

night2_reply_dain_4.name: Dain
night2_reply_dain_4.text: Oh wait mild tteokbokki isn't real tteokbokki lol

night2_reply_dain_5.name: {name}
night2_reply_dain_5.text: *Three messages in a row again. This person never finishes in one sentence.*

night2_reply_seo_1.name: {name}
night2_reply_seo_1.text: Call me and I'll come again

night2_reply_seo_4.name: Seoyeon
night2_reply_seo_4.text: I'll leave the rooftop open at lunch. Actually come this time

night2_reply_seo_5.name: {name}
night2_reply_seo_5.text: *She made it sound optional, but the tone says something will happen if I don't go.*

night2_reply_yuna_7.name: {name}
night2_reply_yuna_7.text: *The third star? — I open the window and look up at the night sky. Not sure which one is the third. A riddle, very Yuna. — Never tells the answer, but makes you want to find it.*

night2_end_1.name: {name}
night2_end_1.text: *I sent my replies and set the phone down.*

night2_end_2.name: {name}
night2_end_2.text: *Day two is over. On the first day, it was curiosity. I wondered what kind of people they were.*

night2_flashback_1.name: {name}
night2_flashback_1.text: *Minsu's words keep coming back. 'Were you like this at your old school too?'*

night2_flashback_2.name: {name}
night2_flashback_2.text: *I scrolled far back. Three months ago. — A photo. A group shot in front of the library. Sojeong is smiling. Right next to me.*

night2_flashback_3.name: {name}
night2_flashback_3.text: *Back then, I opened my phone every night. Typed something in the notes app and deleted it over and over. — Every time, I stopped right before hitting send.*

night2_flashback_4.name: {name}
night2_flashback_4.text: *Then one day in March, during morning announcements, the guy next to me said, 'Sojeong's got a boyfriend.'*

night2_flashback_5.name: {name}
night2_flashback_5.text: *The simulations in my notes app stopped at number 38. There's no number 39. There was no need to write one.*

night2_flashback_6.name: {name}
night2_flashback_6.text: *The transfer wasn't because of Sojeong. It was my dad's job. — But I didn't mind leaving. It meant I wouldn't have to walk past Sojeong's smile in the hallway every day.*

night2_flashback_7.name: {name}
night2_flashback_7.text: *'This time, no more regrets.' — That's the promise I made when I came to this school.*

night2_flashback_8.name: {name}
night2_flashback_8.text: *I closed the gallery. Thought about deleting the photo — but left it. Deleting it would feel like erasing the regret too.*

night2_end_3.name: {name}
night2_end_3.text: *There's still distance between 'on my mind' and 'in love.' — But that distance feels shorter than yesterday.*

night2_end_4.name: {name}
night2_end_4.text: *I close my eyes. — Maybe I should be a little more honest tomorrow.*

night2_seo_freetalk.name: Seoyeon
night2_seo_freetalk.context: Night 2, chatting with Seoyeon. Conversation feels more natural than yesterday. Tone: Feeling closer than yesterday. Banter feels natural and comfortable. Push-pull flirting. No heavy topics yet.
night2_seo_freetalk.personality: Seoyeon is the cool student council president. She shows a more honest side at night.

night2_dain_freetalk.name: Dain
night2_dain_freetalk.context: Night 2, chatting with Dain. Tone: Feeling closer than yesterday. Banter feels natural and comfortable. Push-pull flirting. No heavy topics yet.
night2_dain_freetalk.personality: Dain is energetic even at night, but sometimes gets serious.

night2_yuna_freetalk.name: Yuna
night2_yuna_freetalk.context: Night 2, chatting with Yuna. She's more talkative than usual. Tone: Feeling closer than yesterday. Banter feels natural and comfortable. Push-pull flirting. No heavy topics yet.
night2_yuna_freetalk.personality: Yuna is a mysterious literary girl. Her walls lower a bit at night. Longer messages mean she's opening up.

night2_hidden_check.name: {name}
night2_hidden_check.text: *Between the messenger alerts — I spot more notifications.*

night2_hidden_homeroom_1.name: {name}
night2_hidden_homeroom_1.text: *A private message from the homeroom teacher. '{name}, thanks for coming to the office today. The paperwork's done so I won't need to call you in again. ...But if adjusting gets tough, come by anytime.'*

night2_hidden_homeroom_2.name: {name}
night2_hidden_homeroom_2.text: *Three lines. Gratitude, distance, then reaching out again. — She's playing tug of war with herself.*

night2_hidden_homeroom_3.name: {name}
night2_hidden_homeroom_3.text: *'Won't need to call you in' and 'come by anytime' in the same message. Contradictory — but that's so her.*

night2_hidden_nurse_1.name: {name}
night2_hidden_nurse_1.text: *Health app notification. 'Nurse's Record: {name} — Elbow abrasion (minor). Note: I'll change the bandage tomorrow morning. Changing bandages is a medical procedure so you can't refuse ^^'*

night2_hidden_nurse_2.name: {name}
night2_hidden_nurse_2.text: *Can't refuse. — Is that medical authority or personal interest? The emoji blurs the line.*

night2_reply_dain_react_high.name: Dain
night2_reply_dain_react_high.text: DUDEEE!!!!! I'm literally rolling around in bed laughing rn LOL!! You HAVE to come to the gym tomorrow!!

night2_reply_seo_react_high.name: Seoyeon
night2_reply_seo_react_high.text: ...You're more interesting than I expected. Want to come to the rooftop for lunch tomorrow?

night2_reply_seo_react_default.name: Seoyeon
night2_reply_seo_react_default.text: Heh. Got it. See you tomorrow.

night2_reply_yuna_react_high.name: Yuna
night2_reply_yuna_react_high.text: ...So there's someone who texts back at this hour. Want to come to the library tomorrow?

night2_reply_yuna_6_ins.name: {name}
night2_reply_yuna_6_ins.text: *The third star? — I open the window and look up at the night sky. Not sure which one is the third.*

night2_reply_yuna_6_ins2.name: {name}
night2_reply_yuna_6_ins2.text: *A very Yuna riddle. A person who never gives you the answer. — A person who makes you want to find out.*

night2_reply_yuna_6_ins3.name: {name}
night2_reply_yuna_6_ins3.text: *Between the messenger alerts — a personal message from the homeroom teacher arrives.*

night2_reply_yuna_6_ins4.name: Homeroom Teacher
night2_reply_yuna_6_ins4.text: *{name}, thanks for coming to the faculty office today*

night2_reply_yuna_6_ins5.name: Homeroom Teacher
night2_reply_yuna_6_ins5.text: *The admin stuff is done so I won't need to call you in again*

night2_reply_yuna_6_ins6.name: Homeroom Teacher
night2_reply_yuna_6_ins6.text: *...But if you're having a hard time adjusting, come anytime*

night2_end_2_ins.name: {name}
night2_end_2_ins.text: *Today is — different. It's not curiosity anymore. I'm thinking about them. What they're doing, what they'll say tomorrow.*

night2_end_2_ins2.name: {name}
night2_end_2_ins2.text: *Minsu's words keep coming back. 'Were you like this at your old school?'*

night2_end_3_ins.name: {name}
night2_end_3_ins.text: *The problem is, that distance is closing faster than expected.*

night2_end_4_ins.name: {name}
night2_end_4_ins.text: *I open the fridge. Not much there. Leftover rice, eggs, seaweed. — I find myself wanting to pack something to bring tomorrow. For who? I'm not sure. I just want to.*

night2_end_4_ins2.name: {name}
night2_end_4_ins2.text: *I threw together a lunch box. It's not great. Too rough to call it made with care. — But it's better than nothing.*
